title: indigo_agent_astrometry: execute_command() leaks the getline() buffer allocated at end of output (120 bytes per solver command)
summary: In execute_command() the loop frees the line after every getline() call, but getline() allocates a new buffer for the final call that returns -1 at end of output, and that buffer is never freed (no free(line) after the loop). Valgrind on build/integration/test_agent_astrometry "solve with filter" reports 120 bytes definitely lost per image2xy/solve-field command (three per solve). Pre-existing, not caused by the solve-filter change; outside its scope. Proposed fix: free(line) after the while loop.
